login.subtitle: Log in to continue your training journal

register.subtitle: Create an account — you'll get 13 starter exercises right away

dashboard.title: Training Journal
dashboard.emptyJournal: No workouts yet. Click "New workout" to start.

programs.title: Programs
programs.emptyState: No programs yet. Create one and you can start a workout from it in one click, even without prior history.
programs.deleteConfirmDescription: «{{name}}» will be deleted. Workouts already created from it are unaffected.

form.tryMoreAfterWorkoutsLabel: "Try more" after N workouts without progress
form.tryMoreAfterWorkoutsHint: Only actually-logged workouts with this exercise count - skipped days don't add to the count, but don't reset it either. Leave blank to keep the default rule (14 calendar days without progress).
form.errorTargetSets: Set the target number of sets (at least 1) for every exercise.
form.errorTryMoreAfterWorkouts: The workout count must be at least 1 (or leave it blank).

workout.saveAsProgramErrorNoExercises: There are no exercises in this workout to save.
workout.deleteConfirmDescription: This can't be undone — every exercise and set in this workout will be lost for good.
workout.emptySetError: Every added exercise needs at least one set with reps filled in.
workout.removeExerciseConfirmDescription: «{{name}}» and all its logged sets will be removed from this workout.

progress.title: Exercise progress
progress.weeklyVolumeDescription: Balance of load between large and small muscle groups — check small groups aren't neglected.

charts.workingWeightDescription: The weight used for this exercise in that workout — fixed for the whole exercise, doesn't change between sets. The larger outlined point is a personal weight record.
charts.workingWeightEmpty: This exercise is done without weight
charts.maxRepsDescription: The highest rep count among all sets in that workout (not the sum, not the average). The larger outlined point is a personal reps record.
charts.oneRepMaxDescription: One-rep max — how much you could theoretically lift for 1 rep, via the Epley formula: weight × (1 + reps / 30). Combines weight and reps into a single strength metric, so it keeps rising even when weight drops for higher reps. A rough estimate — the formula gets unreliable past 15+ reps.
charts.oneRepMaxEmpty: This exercise is done without weight
charts.volumeDescriptionWeighted: Total work for the session: weight × sum of reps across all sets. Grows even when weight and max reps stay flat — from doing more sets.
charts.volumeDescriptionBodyweight: For bodyweight exercises — just the sum of reps across all sets in the session.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.archiveConfirmDescription: The exercise will be removed from the list. Set history in already-saved workouts stays intact.

schedule.title: Training schedule
schedule.description: Planned training days — used by the journal's calendar to spot missed days.

import.title: Import from Google Sheets
import.description: Export your workout spreadsheet as CSV (File → Download → Comma-separated values) and upload the file here. The format must match your original sheet: date on the first set's row, an "exercise" + "weight" column pair per exercise.

message.no_data: No entries for this exercise yet.
message.start_adding_weight: Reached {{repRangeMax}} reps with no weight — time to start adding some.
message.increase_weight: Reached the top of the range ({{repRangeMax}} reps) — add +{{weightStep}} kg per side.
message.try_more: No progress for {{days}} days — try more reps or weight.
message.try_more_sessions: No progress for {{sessions}} workouts — try more reps or weight.

errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists
errors.invalid_refresh_token: Your session has expired, please log in again
errors.invalid_exercises: One of the exercises isn't in your list anymore
